📖 How to update the Port Store landing page

Step-by-step guide to generating code and uploading to BigCommerce. You need BC admin login — contact the ecommerce manager if you don’t have access.

1
Upload your images to BigCommerce first
Upload all images to BC Image Manager before generating code. This gives you the CDN URLs to paste into the editor fields.
BC Admin → Storefront → Image Manager → Upload Files
Click the image → copy URL starting with cdn11.bigcommerce.com
💡 Upload the largest version you have — BigCommerce resizes automatically.
2
Select a module and generate your code
Go back to All Modules, select the module you want to update, fill in the fields and click Generate Code, then Copy.
📢 Announcement Bar
🖼️ Main Banner
🛍 Product Grid
💡 You can update each module independently.
3
Open Page Builder in BigCommerce
Log in and navigate to the landing page in Page Builder.
BC Admin → Storefront → My Themes → Customize
Navigate to the landing page using the browser bar inside Page Builder
4
Click the correct HTML Widget
Hover over the section you want to update — a pencil edit icon appears. Click it to open the code editor.
📢 Hover over the teal strip at the top
🖼️ Hover over the full-width image below the nav
🛍 Hover over the product cards below the banner
⚠️ Make sure you click the correct widget. Check the highlighted section visually matches what you want to change.
5
Select all and replace with your new code
Select all existing code in the widget editor and replace it completely with your generated code.
Select all: Ctrl + A (Windows) or Cmd + A (Mac)
Paste: Ctrl + V or Cmd + V
💡 Always replace completely — never paste on top of old code.
6
Save the widget, then Publish the page
Widget editor → Apply or Save
Page Builder toolbar (top right) → Publish
⚠️ Apply alone does not make it live. You must also click Publish in the Page Builder toolbar.
7
Check the live store
Hard refresh: Ctrl + Shift + R (Windows) or Cmd + Shift + R (Mac)
💡 Use F12 → mobile icon in DevTools to check the mobile layout.

📦 Managing Products in BigCommerce

How to find, edit and manage product listings in the BigCommerce admin panel. This covers the product list, editing a product’s details, categories, description and images.

📍 How to get to the product list
BigCommerce Admin → Products → View
The product list — shows all products with name, categories, stock, price and status. Click a product name to open and edit it.
1
Find the product you want to edit
Use the search bar at the top of the product list to find a product by name. You can also filter by category or status. Click the product name to open it.
Click any product name (blue link) to open the product editor
💡 The ENABLED green badge means the product is visible on the storefront. If it shows DISABLED, customers can’t see it.
2
Edit Basic Information
The Basic Information section is the first thing you see when you open a product. This is where you update the core product details.
Basic Information panel — Product Name, SKU, Price, Brand and Product Type
Product Name
The name shown to customers on the storefront and in search results. Keep it clear and consistent with other product names.
SKU
Stock keeping unit — your internal product code. Used for inventory tracking. Don’t change this unless instructed.
Default Price
The price shown to customers including tax. Update this when running sales or correcting pricing errors.
Brand
The brand/manufacturer. Used for filtering and display. Select from the dropdown — do not type a new one without approval.
⚠️ Always click Save at the bottom of the page after making changes. Navigating away without saving will lose your edits.
3
Edit Categories and Description
Scroll down past Basic Information to find Categories and Description. Categories control which pages the product appears on. The description is shown on the product page.
Categories (top) and Description editor (bottom). Tick/untick category checkboxes to add or remove the product from a page.
Categories
Tick the categories this product should appear in. For example, ticking First Nations 2026 adds it to that landing page collection. You can tick multiple categories.
Description
Rich text shown on the product detail page. Use the toolbar to format text. Keep the tone consistent with other product descriptions.
💡 If a product isn’t showing on a collection page, check that the correct category is ticked here.
4
Manage Product Images
Scroll down to the Images section. The first image (marked THUMBNAIL) is the main image shown in product grids and search results. You can add, reorder and remove images here.
Images section — the THUMBNAIL badge marks the main image. Click + to upload new images. Click Remove to delete one.
Thumbnail image
The first image is automatically set as the thumbnail. To change it, drag a different image to the first position or re-upload.
Alt text
Describes the image for screen readers and SEO. Fill this in for every image — use a clear description e.g. PA First Nations Guernsey front view.
💡 Best image size: 800×800px or larger, JPG or PNG, under 1MB. BigCommerce will resize for different display sizes automatically.
⚠️ Deleting an image is permanent and cannot be undone. Make sure you have the file saved locally before removing it.
5
Save your changes
After editing any section, scroll to the bottom of the product page and click Save. Changes are live on the store immediately after saving — no separate publish step is needed for product edits.
Scroll to bottom of product page → click Save
⚠️ Unlike Page Builder, product edits go live immediately on save. Double-check your changes before saving.
📋 Product Editor Quick Reference
SectionWhat you can editNotes
Basic InformationName, SKU, price, brand, product typePrice includes tax. Don’t change SKU without checking inventory impact.
CategoriesWhich collection pages the product appears onTick multiple categories. Changes take effect immediately on save.
DescriptionRich text product descriptionUse the toolbar for formatting. Keep tone consistent.
ImagesAdd, reorder and remove product imagesFirst image = thumbnail. Fill in alt text for every image. Min 800×800px recommended.
PricingSale price, cost price, bulk pricingUse Sale Price field for promotions rather than changing the default price.
InventoryStock level, track inventory on/offOnly edit if you manage inventory manually. Sync with POS if applicable.
